result:
I applied the round 243 fix (C-R242-01). Before handing over I ran typecheck, lint, the 67 test files that cover the change, the three mutant tests and the browser probe; everything matched B's expected results. C has not checked anything yet, and I did not mark the backlog item done.

**The bug:** you focus a track Volume fader, the BPM field, the loop brace or a marker flag, right-click an empty lane, then press Escape or pick a grid size. Focus ended up on the page body instead of going back to that control. The fix saves which element had focus at the moment of the right press, before the timeline takes focus away from it. The second, later place that saved it is removed, so only one place does that now.

**Changed files (only the three B allowed):**
- `StudioWorkspace.tsx`: B's patch applied exactly. 3 lines added, 4 removed.
- `grid-snap-menu.test.tsx`: B's test changes. FR3 now expects focus to return to the loop brace; GM40–GM43 are new.
- New doc `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/187-c-r242-01-menu-edit-focus-return.md`, in Georgian. Line 4 reads `Completed (C round 243 PASS)`, as the rules require.

The code diff matches B's patch line for line. The 1,102 frozen files and the 4 root files have the same hashes as at the start, and no protected file was touched.

**Checks I ran:**
- **Static checks:** `npm run typecheck` passed. `npm run lint` passed with 205 warnings that were already there. Biome on the two code files needed no fixes.
- **Covering tests:** 67/67 files and 1153/1153 tests passed. The slowest test took 2.51 s against a 20 s limit, so no test is close to its timeout.
- **Mutants** (on a copy outside the repo; the repo's `git status` was the same before and after): each failed exactly the tests B predicted.
  - MU-LANE-CAPTURE-ONLY failed FR3 and GM40–43.
  - MU-NO-SCROLLER-CAPTURE failed FR3, GM36, GM37, GM39 and GM40–43.
  - MU-PRESS-WINS failed GM38.
  - The unmodified fix passed 47/47.
- **Browser** (Chromium on the running `:5173` server, 1440×900 and 1280×720): after Escape, focus went back to the fader, BPM field, loop brace and marker flag, each showing the brass 1px focus ring. After choosing `0.5 s` with the mouse, focus is on the fader with no ring, which is expected for a mouse choice. There were 0 page errors. The first fader run timed out waiting 120 s for the demo to load on a cold start, the same thing B saw; one rerun passed at both sizes.
- **Marker name editor:** still ends on the page body, and the marker gets committed. B filed this separately as B-R242-MARKER-EDITOR-MENU-FOCUS.

**Code review** (code-reviewer agent): 8/10, nothing Critical, High or Medium. I did not fix its three Low findings, because each would change the code or tests beyond B's exact patch and break the scope check. They are listed for B:
- **A-R243-REVIEW-L1:** the saved element is never cleared after a right press that opens no menu. A one-line change would clear it on every press.
- **A-R243-REVIEW-L2:** no test checks that a right press on a track header or the ruler still loses focus and does not get it back.
- **A-R243-REVIEW-L3:** a setup check in GM40–42 can never fail, because the test helper removes focus by hand. The final focus checks do depend on the fix; the mutants show this.

I fixed its doc wording points in doc 187. Doc 186 still describes the old location of the focus-saving code, but it is frozen, so a note pointing to doc 187 is for B or root to add. The reviewer's architecture note is to keep the code as it is for now; the parked `useGridMenuFocusReturn` hook extraction stays a proposal for B and root.

**Left for C:**
- C-BRACE-KEYS-243 (a) and (b) in the browser.
- The BPM field still showing its committed value after Escape (§6).
- All other §5 rows.

The full test suite, build, `verify` and e2e smoke belong to the root gate. The purchased-route row is blocked because the backend is unavailable in the cloud.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-243.md`, with logs and 15 screenshots in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-243/`.
